parts.note_add: Dealer/port-installed kit: the 1982 catalogue accessory packages 6132AB (condenser), 6142AB (compressor) and 6152AB (evaporator); S-048 is the dealer installation instruction and its p.13 the circuit, S-001 p.24 section G the factory circuit. R-12 system; no factory charge figure found, only forum estimates.

The 1982 compressor mounting kit (S-005 6142AB-1 item 74) lists the drive belt as 0000-47-5409-03 with the remark (17385): Dayco 17385 is a 17/32 in x 38.77 in cogged V-belt. Check the belt on the car against it and the RockAuto Gates 9385 (994 mm).

Sankyo SD-508 family (Sanden today: 5-cylinder wobble plate, 138 cc, R-12; the R-134a successor is SD5H14); replacement Four Seasons 58033 is a new SD508 with clutch and 5-1/4 in pulley for dealer-installed A/C. S-049 (1980 compressor repair manual) covers the Nippondenso 6P134 swash-plate compressor, not this one. Hose fittings point upward when mounted (S-048 p.2).

Clutch lead wire loops through the open hole in the compressor body so it cannot touch the pulley; it takes the black wire from the A/C relay (S-048 p.9 step 31). Sanden SD-series clutch service values (air gap, shims, torques) are recorded as replacement specs.
Replacement compressor Four Seasons 58033 carries a 5-1/4 in diameter single-groove pulley; check the pulley diameter on the car.

Mounted in front of the radiator inside the cowling: two studs on the passenger-side bracket take 1/4 in kepnuts, the driver side takes two 1/4-20 x 1/2 bolts (S-048 p.3, S-005 p.81). Inlet (3/8 in fitting) at top left when laid flat; left brackets at holes 1-2 and 6-7, right brackets at holes 1-2 and 9-10 from the top (S-048 p.2 step 7). Reproduction made on OE tooling: Auto AC Solutions, replaces 67128508.

Held to its bracket by two bands and two #10-32 x 1/2 screws with kepnuts, bracket to the radiator cowling with two 1/4 in kepnuts (S-048 p.3-4). Four Seasons 33234 (3/8 in flare in/out, switch port, 2.5 x 8 in) is listed for 1981-82 RX-7.

Catalogue calls it the low pressure switch on the receiver-drier (S-005 p.81). In S-001 it is G-21 'refrigerant pressure switch' (YL/YR) in series between the No.1 air-con relay and the frost switch; the dealer circuit drawing (S-048 p.13) shows no pressure switch, so check which wiring the car has.
Attached to the condenser at about 45 degrees upward toward the front of the car (S-048 p.2 step 8).

Routed through a hole in the upper right of the radiator cowling with a grommet, clamped to the lip of the front body panel (#6 clamp, #10-32 screw), to the wheel well by the overflow tank (drilled 1/4 in hole) and to the forward inside stud of the shock tower (8 mm nut); must clear the headlight door mechanism by at least 2 in (S-048 p.10).

Discharge line passes through the hole in the radiator cowling on the driver's side nearest the radiator with a foam protector, is clamped (#8 clamp) to a stand-off bracket and to the frame by the battery box (6 mm bolt), and runs under the car harness to the compressor. Suction hose: 110-degree fitting at the evaporator, 45-degree fitting at the compressor, routed under the hot-start assist cable, clamped by the hood latch (S-048 p.4-5, p.11).

Dealer harness: a white coupler that plugs into the car's OEM coupler (BW and LR wires), a black wire to the compressor clutch, and yellow and blue wires along the firewall to the evaporator harness, tie-wrapped to the hood release cable and the brake vacuum line (S-048 p.9).

Sits between the blower outlet and heater inlet behind the glove box; top case bracket hangs on a stud on the upper dash panel (6 mm nut), lower brackets bolt to the firewall (6 mm nuts), metal seal plates bridge to blower and heater (S-048 p.6-8). A micro-switch on the heater (adjusted so the compressor is off in heat and defrost) and a white short connector on the blower terminals are part of the installation (S-048 p.6-7).
Injection moulded (S-005 p.90).
Catalogue: 'valve, expansion - extension equalizer' with capillary bulb clamp No.1 (S-005 p.90). Aftermarket crosses for 67-0336-81: Four Seasons 38611, ACDelco 15-5768, A-Premium APAEV208.
Aluminium (S-005 p.90).

Catalogue: 'switch, thermostat - preset frosting', i.e. a fixed-setting frost switch on its own bracket (S-005 p.90). S-001 G-22 'frost warning temp switch' LG/YR; in the dealer circuit two yellow wires between relay terminal 5 and the heater micro-switch (S-048 p.13).

Listed in the evaporator package but mounted in the engine bay on an existing screw; if a relay is already there it is turned so the OEM relay tucks under the bracket (S-048 p.9 step 28). Four terminals 1, 3, 4, 5 in the dealer drawing; the factory diagram calls it G-18 No.1 air-con relay (LB, LR, YL, BW).

Blue and yellow wires pass through the firewall (pushed out only to the yellow tape, about 2 in) to meet the relay wires; yellow and green spade terminals go to the heater micro-switch; a green female bullet and a blue male bullet splice into the blower motor's blue/green-stripe wires (S-048 p.7-9).
Grommet in the firewall, 90-degree elbow pushed through from the engine side, hose cut to length at the evaporator drain port and clamped; a hole is cut in the carpet at the drain tube (S-048 p.12).

specs.item: Refrigerant
specs.note: 1980 Nippondenso compressor repair manual: 'charge the refrigerant (R-12)'. Ross Air Works lists the SD 508 as an R12 compressor (src-ross-sanden p.1). No 1982 document states the system refrigerant.

specs.item: Refrigerant charge, forum estimate for a 1985 (R-12)
specs.note: Forum member's figure for his 1985, offered for an 1983; no label or manual cited. Another owner (rx7club, src-rx7club-ac-capacity) says 2 lb R-12 for an 85 GSL-SE. Charge by gauges.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD (TXV system): total system oil for 24-40 oz refrigerant charges
specs.note: Sanden's figure for a passenger-car single-evaporator expansion-valve system; oil circulation ratio 3.3-8 % by weight (p.9).

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD: discharge pressure, short-term peak maximum
specs.note: Limited term (extended idle) 400 psig max.

specs.item: Drive belt in the 1982 compressor mounting kit: part 0000-47-5409-03, remark (17385)
specs.note: Catalogue remark in brackets reads as the Dayco belt number 17385. The parts row's oem_no 0000-68-110-00 comes from another figure; check which belt is on the car.

specs.item: Replacement Dayco 17385: top width
specs.note: 13.5 mm; belt section AW-17, cogged.

specs.item: Replacement Dayco 17385: outside length
specs.note: 984 mm. The RockAuto Gates 9385 in the part's link is 39.12 in / 994 mm x 12 mm (from its more-info page).

specs.item: Belt deflection, air conditioner belt
specs.note: 1985 workshop manual pre-delivery inspection (0.39-0.47 in). No 1982 figure found; S-038 gives only alternator and air pump belts.

specs.item: Replacement Four Seasons 58033: new SD508 compressor with clutch, dealer-installed A/C, pulley diameter
specs.note: PartsGeek fitment note for 1979-1983 RX7: 'New Compressor -- With SD508 Compressor; New With Clutch; Dealer Installed AC; With 5-1/4" Diameter Pulley'.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD 508: cylinders
specs.note: Wobble-plate piston compressor; the catalogue's Sankyo 1573/9157 is the SD-508 family (Sankyo became Sanden).

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD 508: displacement
specs.note: 8.4 cu in. Same figure for SD5H14 in the Sanden service guide p.8.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD 508: weight with clutch
specs.note: Sanden guide p.8 for SD5H14: compressor 5.1 kg, clutch 2.7 kg, assembly 7.8 kg.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD 508: refrigerant
specs.note: Oil type mineral; SD5H14 is the R-134a version with PAG SP-15.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD 508: factory oil charge in compressor
specs.note: +/- 15 cc (6.0 +/- 0.5 oz), mineral oil. SD5H14 (R-134a, expansion valve): 210 +/- 15 cc PAG SP-15.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD 508: rotation
specs.note: Sanden guide p.8 lists SD5H14 as CW only.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD5H14: maximum speed, constant (standard clutch)
specs.note: Downshift 7000 rpm; HD clutch 4000 / 6000.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD508/SD5H14: distance between mounting ears
specs.note: Total ear deflection when bolted must be under 0.4 mm, 0.2 mm per ear.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD: mounting rotation allowed either side of horizontal
specs.note: Oil fill plug must stay above the 3 or 9 o'clock position.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD: oil filler plug torque
Replacement Sanden SD: 3/4 in flare hose fitting torque
Replacement Sanden SD: clutch cycling rate, maximum
Compressor oil, 1980 Nippondenso 6P134 (not this compressor): amount
specs.note: SUNISO 5GS, DENSOIL 6 or equivalent, 13-15 cu in. S-049 is the 1980 6P134 swash-plate manual; the 1982 catalogue lists a Sankyo, so this is background only.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD: cylinder head bolt torque, M8
specs.note: +/- 4.9 N·m (25.3 ft-lb). M6 head bolts 13.7 +/- 2.9 N·m. Check which size the Sankyo head uses.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD clutch: air gap
specs.note: 0.016-0.031 in, feeler gauge; set by shims (1.0, 0.5, 0.1 mm, p.18). A gap over 1.3 mm can prevent engagement when hot (p.13). Over-torqued SD508 dust cover bolts put the gap out of spec.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD clutch: power draw at 12 V
specs.note: Clutch voltage must exceed 11.5 V DC on a 12 V system.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD clutch: armature retaining nut torque, 1/2-20
specs.note: 20-25 ft-lb; M8 nut 15-21 N·m. Assembly table p.8 gives 30.4 +/- 3.9 N·m for 1/2-20.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD-5 clutch: dust cover screw torque, 1/4-20 (3 screws)
specs.note: 2-4 ft-lb, 25-50 kgf-cm.

specs.item: Replacement Four Seasons 58033: pulley outside diameter
specs.note: Single-groove V pulley on the SD508 replacement; check the pulley on the car.

specs.item: Replacement Sanden SD 12 V field coil: resistance at room temperature
specs.note: Sanden diagnostic limit for a 12 V coil (24 V coil 14-18.2 ohm); the guide's figure shows a 3.2 ohm reading.

specs.item: Stator coil resistance at 20 C, 1980 Nippondenso 6P134 clutch (not this compressor)
specs.note: +/- 0.22 ohm. S-049 is the 1980 6P134 manual; the 1982 catalogue lists a Sankyo compressor.

specs.item: Inlet fitting
specs.note: Dealer installation instruction, year not stated: 'inlet (3/8" fitting) is at top left hand side' with the condenser laid flat. The catalogue's liquid hose to the drier is 3/8 O-ring both ends (S-005 p.81).

specs.item: Mounting bracket screws, #10 x 3/4 in hex-washer-head sheet metal, qty
specs.note: Catalogue sack kit carries 14 No.10 x 1/2 tapping screws (S-005 p.81 item 24). check

specs.item: Driver-side bracket bolts 1/4-20 x 1/2 in, qty
specs.note: S-048 p.3 step 9: '(2) 1/4" bolts and flat washers' driver's side; passenger side two studs with 1/4 in kepnuts (catalogue item 21: 1/4-20 keps nuts, qty 4).

specs.item: Replacement Auto AC Solutions condenser: tubing size
specs.note: Built on OE replacement tooling, replaces OE 67128508 / 67126557, fittings to OE spec, $385, made in USA.

specs.item: Replacement Four Seasons 33234: inlet and outlet fittings
specs.note: Male flare both ends, with switch port (0.250 in), steel, no sight glass, desiccant not replaceable; listed for 1981-1982 Mazda RX-7, $37.42.

specs.item: Replacement Four Seasons 33234: body diameter
Replacement Four Seasons 33234: overall length
Band clamp screws #10-32 x 1/2 in Phillips with kepnuts, qty
specs.note: Year not stated. Catalogue: No.10-32 x 1/2 PH machine screws qty 3 and No.10-32 keps nuts qty 3 in the condenser package (S-005 p.81 items 20, 22).

specs.item: Bracket to radiator cowling: 1/4 in kepnuts, qty
specs.note: Year not stated.

specs.item: Hose length (catalogue remark)
specs.note: '3/8 O-RING 90 DEG. x 3/8 O-RING 90 DEG. x 18': 3/8 in O-ring fittings, 90 degree, both ends.

specs.item: Hose length (catalogue remark)
specs.note: '3/8 O-RING X 3/8 O-RING X 66': 3/8 in O-ring fittings both ends.

specs.item: Minimum clearance from the headlight door mechanism
specs.note: Year not stated. Clamps: #6 clamp with #10-32 screw at the front body panel lip, drilled 1/4 in hole at the wheel well, #6 clamp with 8 mm nut on the shock tower stud.

specs.item: Tube block bolt, 10 mm x 1.00 x 35 mm, qty
specs.note: Bolt 0000-67-6716-50 'FOR HOSE & COMPRESSOR FITTING'; O-ring package set 0000-67-0123-38. OCR reads '3SMM'; check 35.

specs.item: Suction hose fitting angle at the evaporator
specs.note: Year not stated; the 45 degree fitting goes to the compressor. Discharge line takes a #8 hose clamp at the stand-off bracket (p.5 step 15).

specs.item: Mounting: top case bracket nut
specs.note: Over a stud on the upper dash panel with a lock washer; lower case brackets (2 each) to the firewall with 6 mm nuts and flat washers. Catalogue screw kit: 6 mm hex nuts qty 3, 1/4 flatwashers qty 3 (S-005 p.90 items 54-55).

specs.item: Seal plate screws, #10 x 3/4 in Phillips sheet metal, qty
specs.note: S-048 p.8 step 23: seal plates on the blower outlet and heater inlet slide against stops on the evaporator.

specs.item: Tube protector 0000-67-1981-03: 7/16 in ID x 7/8 in OD x 2-3/4 in
specs.note: Second protector 0000-67-1981-40 reads 5/8 ID x 1-1/8 OD x 2-1/2 in in the OCR; check.

specs.item: Drain hose inside diameter
specs.note: '1/2 ID X 4 1/2': 4-1/2 in long as supplied, cut to length at the drain port (S-048 p.12). Plastic elbow 90 deg 1/2 OD; grommets 1/2 x 13/16 and 1/2 x 3/8.
